definition.description: REV | Intake | WordPress to Dataverse. Creates the application (FR-007/008), notifies the process owner (FR-009), logs/alerts on failure (FR-010). Derives age range and location area (FR-027). Duplicate-grant check (FR-023) deferred - see notes.md.

metadata.description: Environment variable. Recipient of the FR-009 new-application notification, injected per environment at import (C-TECH-047).

Environment variable. Entra app (client) ID of the WordPress intake registration - SECOND gate only (NFR-008, C-TECH-006); primary control is the trigger's Entra auth. Public identifier, not a secret. See notes.md (client-id vs object-id).

manual.description: The one public endpoint here. PRIMARY control is trigger-level Entra ID auth (NFR-008, C-TECH-006), a trigger setting not a definition property. Concurrency capped at 1: match-or-create is read-then-write. Payload contract changed - see notes.md.

submission_id.description: The Gravity Forms entry id. Written to rev_application.rev_sourcesubmissionid, an alternate key. Alex MUST send the same value on any retry - that is what makes a retry safe.

title.description: rev_title option value. Option list is a PLACEHOLDER pending confirmation.

first_name.description: BREAKING CHANGE: replaces full_name. Written to rev_applicant.rev_firstname. rev_fullname is now a CALCULATED column and cannot be written.

last_name.description: BREAKING CHANGE: replaces full_name. Written to rev_applicant.rev_lastname.

preferred_contact_method.description: Email/Phone/Post, one or more. Raw export cols 26-28 (three separate checkboxes). Written to rev_applicant.rev_preferredcontactmethod. See notes.md.

applicant_type.description: rev_applicanttype option value. Option list is a PLACEHOLDER pending confirmation.

gender.description: rev_gender option value. Equality monitoring only - never reaches a scoring or eligibility expression. Ethnic group is deliberately NOT accepted: see SDD OQ-027.

helper_relationship.description: rev_helperrelationship free text. Confirmed 2026-08-16: real field is free text, not a choice.

support_recipient_other_condition_raw.description: Closes form-spec OPEN-3. Sent only when the support recipient's condition profile includes Other.

care_support_description.description: Care the APPLICANT needs day to day.

care_hours_per_week.description: Raw export col 94, one of five bands the live form sends (D-4). Matched against a configured label map; unmatched values leave the column empty and are recorded (FR-064). See notes.md.

break_type.description: rev_breaktype option value. Option list is a PLACEHOLDER pending confirmation.

other_break_type.description: Sent only when break_type is the Other option.

exceptional_circumstance.description: CORRECTED 2026-08-17: a 4-option category, not Yes/No (see rev_exceptionalfundingrequested). Matched against a configured label map; unmatched values leave the column empty and are recorded (FR-064). See notes.md.

employment_status.description: RENAMED from currently_working, 2026-08-17: real field is five options, not Yes/No (D-3). Matched against a configured label map; unmatched values leave the column empty and are recorded (FR-064). See notes.md.

consent_explanation.description: Raw export col 49, 'Explanation'. Written to rev_application.rev_consentexplanation.

feeling_scale_answer.description: ONS life-satisfaction answer (raw col 95). Whole number 0-10 inclusive (changed from 1-5 in 0.3). Send as given - do not invert/rescale. 0 is valid; omit only if unanswered (FR-022). Bounded 0-10 since 0.8 (test D-014). See notes.md.

Reject_caller_that_is_not_the_charity_we.description: NFR-008/C-TECH-006, SECOND gate only - primary control is the trigger's Entra auth (see trigger). Re-checks caller's client id against rev_IntakeAllowedClientId. Defence in depth. Terse rejection - reveals nothing. See notes.md.

Stop_run_unauthorised.description: Cancelled, not Failed. An unauthorised caller is not a system fault and must not raise a failure alert to the process owner - otherwise a scanner hitting the endpoint becomes a Teams notification.

Reject_incomplete_payload.description: C-TECH-004: validate payload before any write. Incomplete payload means the form was bypassed or misconfigured (FR-010). NOTE: the eleven scored answers are NOT required - a missing one withholds scoring (FR-022) rather than rejecting. See notes.md.

Compose_run_link_for_the_rejection.description: Builds the deep link to THIS run and passes it to REV | Ops | Failure Alert. Both parts come from workflow() at run time, so nothing is hardcoded. It must be built here: workflow() in the child returns the child. See notes.md.

Log_incomplete_payload.description: FR-010. Reference only - the submission id, never the payload. Severity Warning rather than Error: the platform is healthy, the caller is not.

body.text_2: Incomplete intake payload rejected: one or more of submission_id, first_name, last_name, postcode was absent or empty.

Respond_400_incomplete.description: Names the required fields so Alex can fix the integration, and returns nothing else. The applicant never sees this - Alex's specification requires the website to show a plain-English message instead.

Initialise_failure_detail.description: Holds the failed action name and reason for the alert. Declared at the TOP level: the scope that fails is skipped from the failure onward, so nothing inside it can carry a value out.

Create_the_application.description: Everything that touches Dataverse sits in one scope so a single run-after path catches every failure below it (power-automate.md: every flow has a top-level Scope with a parallel failure branch).

Find_application_with_this_submission_id.description: THE IDEMPOTENCY GUARD (TAD section 5.1). rev_sourcesubmissionid is an alternate key, so this is an indexed lookup. Runs before any write.

Return_the_existing_reference_if_this_is.description: A replayed webhook returns the original reference and writes nothing - deliberately update-free, so it can't silently overwrite a process-owner override (FR-018). Narrows TAD 5.1 - reviewer to confirm (Dev Summary D-2). See notes.md.

Stop_run_replay.description: Succeeded, not Cancelled: a correctly-handled replay is a success, and marking it Cancelled would make the run history read as though something went wrong.

Read_configuration.description: Every label/band map here is read at RUN TIME from rev_setting by ONE List rows call for all six rows - was six Get-a-row-by-id calls the connector rejects on an alternate-key Row ID (IMP-0112, same defect the scoring flow had). See notes.md.

Read_intake_configuration.description: FR-017/FR-027/FR-064. ONE List rows call for the six rev_setting rows this flow needs, replacing six Get-a-row-by-id-by-alternate-key calls the connector rejects (IMP-0112). See notes.md.

parameters.$filter: rev_name eq 'AgeBandMap' or rev_name eq 'PostcodeRegionMap' or rev_name eq 'AgeRangeLabelMap' or rev_name eq 'ExceptionalCircumstanceLabelMap' or rev_name eq 'EmploymentStatusLabelMap' or rev_name eq 'CareHoursBandLabelMap'

Fail_if_a_setting_row_is_missing.description: A missing row was a 404 under Get-a-row-by-id; under List rows it is a short array, silently degrading age/location/label derivation instead of failing loudly. All 6 rows required. See notes.md.

Stop_run_configuration_incomplete.description: Fails the run so REV | Ops | Failure Alert records it. Deriving an age range, a location area or a label mapping from a partial configuration would produce a plausible wrong value, which is worse than none.

runError.message: Expected 6 rev_setting rows and found @{length(body('Read_intake_configuration')?['value'])}. Run provisioning/dataverse/seed-settings.ps1 for this environment. No application was created.

Setting_AgeBandMap.description: FR-027. The map lives in rev_setting so the bands can be changed without touching this flow (NFR-019, ADR-010).

Setting_AgeRangeLabelMap.description: Maps the form's age-range labels to rev_agerange option values. The live form asks an age band directly (no date of birth), so this is the primary source; the date-of-birth derivation below is a fallback. See notes.md.

Setting_ExceptionalCircumstanceLabelMap.description: FR-064/W1. Maps the form's exceptional-circumstance labels to rev_exceptionalcircumstance option values. See notes.md.

Setting_EmploymentStatusLabelMap.description: FR-064/W2. Maps the form's employment-status labels to rev_employmentstatus option values. See notes.md.

Setting_CareHoursBandLabelMap.description: FR-064/W5. Maps the form's care-hours band labels to rev_carehoursperweek option values. See notes.md.

Compute_age_in_years.description: Exact completed years: subtract birth year, minus one more if the birthday hasn't occurred yet this year. Band boundaries matter. Returns -1 when no usable date of birth was supplied, turned into 'Not known' next. See notes.md.

Match_age_bands.description: AgeBandMap rows are held in ascending maxAge order, preserved here, so the first match is the narrowest band containing the age. Re-ordering the JSON silently degrades this - documented at both ends. See notes.md.

Map_age_range_label.description: Matches the age-range label the form sent against the configured map. Empty when no age_range was sent or the label is not in the map - the flow never guesses a band.

Derive_age_range.description: The age band the applicant chose on the form wins. Falls back to the band derived from a date of birth if one was supplied, and to 9 (Not known) when neither is available. 9 is honest, not a guess - see rev_agerange's own description.

Compute_outward_code.description: The outward code is everything before the space in a UK postcode. Works for 'BT1 1AA' and for 'BT11AA' with no space, because only the leading letters are used below.

Compute_postcode_prefixes.description: Two candidates: UK postcode areas are one or two letters, and the two-letter reading must win ('BT1' -> Northern Ireland on 'BT', not West Midlands on 'B'). Logic Apps has no regex, so this fallback replaces one. See notes.md.

Derive_location_area.description: FR-027. Two-letter area wins, one-letter area is the fallback, and option 13 'Not known' is the honest answer for an unrecognised postcode. As with the age band, the flow never guesses a region.

Map_exceptional_circumstance_label.description: Normalised match (trim/case/dash) against the configured map. Empty when unsent or unmatched - never guessed. See notes.md.

Derive_exceptional_circumstance.description: Null (not a guess) when the label sent doesn't match a configured option - FR-064.

Map_employment_status_label.description: Normalised match (trim/case) against the configured map. Empty when unsent or unmatched - never guessed. See notes.md.

Derive_employment_status.description: Null (not a guess) when the label sent doesn't match a configured option - FR-064.

Map_care_hours_band_label.description: Normalised match (trim/case/dash) - the D-4 band labels carry en-dashes in some sources and hyphens in others. Empty when unsent or unmatched. See notes.md.

Derive_care_hours_band.description: Null (not a guess) when the label sent doesn't match a configured option - FR-064.

Normalise_contact_method_labels.description: W3. Lower-cases and trims each label the form sent, so the fixed Email/Phone/Post check below is case- and whitespace-insensitive.

Derive_preferred_contact_method.description: Comma-separated option values for the multi-select rev_preferredcontactmethod (rev_contactmethod: Email=1, Phone=2, Post=3). See notes.md.
Derive_preferred_contact_method.inputs: @join(union(if(contains(body('Normalise_contact_method_labels'), 'email'), createArray('1'), createArray()), if(contains(body('Normalise_contact_method_labels'), 'phone'), createArray('2'), createArray()), if(contains(body('Normalise_contact_method_labels'), 'post'), createArray('3'), createArray())), ',')

Derive_intake_review_note.description: FR-064. Names any of the three re-mapped fields whose sent value matched no configured option - written to rev_intakereviewnote instead of being silently dropped. See notes.md.
Derive_intake_review_note.inputs: @trim(concat(if(and(not(empty(coalesce(triggerBody()?['exceptional_circumstance'], ''))), equals(outputs('Derive_exceptional_circumstance'), null)), concat('exceptional_circumstance: "', triggerBody()?['exceptional_circumstance'], '" not in the option list. '), ''), if(and(not(empty(coalesce(triggerBody()?['employment_status'], ''))), equals(outputs('Derive_employment_status'), null)), concat('employment_status: "', triggerBody()?['employment_status'], '" not in the option list. '), ''), if(and(not(empty(coalesce(triggerBody()?['care_hours_per_week'], ''))), equals(outputs('Derive_care_hours_band'), null)), concat('care_hours_per_week: "', triggerBody()?['care_hours_per_week'], '" not in the option list. '), '')))

Find_existing_applicant.description: Matches on email + name when an email was collected (only when Email is the preferred contact method); otherwise falls back to name + postcode, the only identity the form guarantees. See notes.md.

parameters.$filter: @if(empty(coalesce(triggerBody()?['email'], '')), concat('rev_firstname eq ''', replace(trim(triggerBody()?['first_name']), '''', ''''''), ''' and rev_lastname eq ''', replace(trim(triggerBody()?['last_name']), '''', ''''''), ''' and rev_postcode eq ''', replace(trim(coalesce(triggerBody()?['postcode'], '')), '''', ''''''), ''''), concat('rev_email eq ''', replace(toLower(trim(triggerBody()?['email'])), '''', ''''''), ''' and rev_firstname eq ''', replace(trim(triggerBody()?['first_name']), '''', ''''''), ''' and rev_lastname eq ''', replace(trim(triggerBody()?['last_name']), '''', ''''''), ''''))

Create_or_refresh_the_applicant.description: One person, one applicant row. On a repeat application, derived columns and rev_lastcontactdate are refreshed rather than creating a second row - a stale rev_lastcontactdate would delete a live case early. See notes.md.

Refresh_existing_applicant.description: Does NOT overwrite rev_privacynoticeacceptedon (evidence of first notice) or rev_firstname/rev_lastname/rev_email (the match keys). rev_fullname is calculated and can't be written. See notes.md.

Create_new_applicant.description: rev_name is an autonumber (REV-A-nnnnn), not set here. ADR-013: the primary name column is a pseudonymised reference, never the person's name. rev_fullname is calculated, not set here either. See notes.md.

Resolve_applicant_id.description: One value from whichever branch ran, so the create step below has a single reference to bind to.

Create_application.description: FR-007/FR-008. rev_name autonumber enforces REV-YYYY-NNN; rev_status set to 1 Submitted. Costs/financial-answers/referee/emergency-contact columns intentionally absent - see notes.md for the full field map and the 17 secured columns written here.

DEFERRED_call_duplicate_grant_check.description: CALL SITE PLACEHOLDER, not dead code. FR-023's QuickBooks duplicate-grant check (Automation #7) is deferred (Dev Summary section 7) - this marks the insertion point. Writes nothing. See notes.md.
DEFERRED_call_duplicate_grant_check.inputs: FR-023 duplicate check deferred to Automation #7. Insert the REV | Duplicate | QBO Check child-flow call here, passing @{outputs('Create_application')?['body/rev_applicationid']}.

Notify_process_owner_of_new_application.description: FR-009 requires the applicant NAME and reference, so unlike every other notification this one deliberately carries personal data. ADR-015: 1:1 chat to the process owner only, not a channel. See notes.md.

parameters.body/messageBody:
New grant application received

Applicant: @{concat(trim(triggerBody()?['first_name']), ' ', trim(triggerBody()?['last_name']))}
Reference: @{outputs('Create_application')?['body/rev_name']}
Received: @{formatDateTime(utcNow(), 'dd MMM yyyy HH:mm')} UTC

Scoring runs automatically. You will be notified again only if this application comes out Borderline or if a scored answer was missing.

Respond_201_created.description: Responds success even if the Teams notification failed: the application record exists, so the submission succeeded, and an error here would make the site retry and alarm the applicant for nothing. See notes.md.

Find_the_failed_action.description: The child of the failed scope whose status is Failed. result(scope)[0] was used before and returns the FIRST child, whose message on a nested scope is a generic wrapper - 11 alerts once said only "An action failed".

Describe_the_failure.description: When the failed child is the nested Read_configuration scope, descend to the action that actually failed - result() on a scope gives a generic wrapper message (IMP-0109). Otherwise the outer child IS the leaf. See notes.md.

Find_the_failed_step_inside_Read_configu.description: Only evaluated when Read_configuration is the failure, so result() on it is safe.

Set_failure_detail_from_the_nested_scope.description: The leaf action inside the nested scope - the one with the real message.

inputs.name: failureDetail
inputs.value: @{concat('Action: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_Read_configuration'))?['name'], 'unknown'), ' | Code: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_Read_configuration'))?['error']?['code'], 'none'), ' | Reason: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_Read_configuration'))?['error']?['message'], 'no message supplied by the platform'))}

Set_failure_detail.description: The failed child was not a scope, so it is already the leaf.

inputs.name: failureDetail
inputs.value: @{concat('Action: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_action'))?['name'], 'unknown'), ' | Code: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_action'))?['error']?['code'], 'none'), ' | Reason: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_action'))?['error']?['message'], 'no message supplied by the platform'))}

Compose_run_link.description: Builds the deep link to THIS run and passes it to REV | Ops | Failure Alert. Both parts come from workflow() at run time, so nothing is hardcoded. It must be built here: workflow() in the child returns the child. See notes.md.

Alert_on_failure.description: FR-010: no submission is silently lost. Passes only the submission id as the record reference so it can be identified and re-sent - nothing else from the payload, which carries special-category data (NFR-012, C-DOM-004).

Respond_500_intake_failed.description: Tells the site to retry with the SAME submission_id - safe due to the idempotency guard above. Returns no diagnostic detail: the applicant must never see a raw error, nor the endpoint its internals to an unauthenticated caller.

body.guidance: Retry with the same submission_id. Duplicate submissions are rejected safely.
